How to read the styles

Orange solid circles show local search radii. Charcoal dotted circles show contract-fleet radii. Brown dashed circles show Maps advertising radii. Green municipality pins are distinct from all radius areas.

Green state fills mark statewide search. Peach county shapes mark coastal Texas targets. Illinois has diagonal exclusion hatching.

A map with a specific purpose

Targets are not a promise of service.

Use this reference to understand geographic advertising strategy, not to decide whether a delivery can be made.

  1. Targeting is conditional. Radius shading shows nominal positive-distance areas. Other exclusions, presence or interest settings and platform matching still apply.
  2. Geography is simplified. State and county shapes are vector boundaries. Pins are locators, city boundaries are not drawn, and no municipality radius is implied.
  3. Delivery is a separate question. The map neither guarantees availability nor indicates that deliveries occur outside a targeted area.
  4. A dated snapshot. This is a manually refreshed October 21, 2026 reference, not a connection to an advertising account.

Basemap: U.S. Census-derived US Atlas state and county geometry. Radius areas use geodesic circles on a spherical Earth. Alaska and Hawaii use inset projections.
